items.prompt:
Improving the ideas and organization of a draft is:
A) revising
B) editing
C) printing

Fixing spelling and punctuation is:
A) editing
B) revising
C) planning

Feedback from classmates is called:
A) peer feedback
B) a conclusion
C) a citation

A reader says your essay doesn't clearly serve its PURPOSE. Fixing this is:
A) revising
B) editing
C) proofreading

You fix three comma errors and a misspelling. This is:
A) editing
B) revising
C) planning

Adding evidence so the argument better fits its audience is:
A) revising
B) editing
C) formatting

Which change is REVISING, not editing?
A) rewriting a weak introduction so it clearly addresses the audience
B) fixing a typo
C) adding a missing period
items.answer: A) rewriting a weak introduction so it clearly addresses the audience

solution.answer: A) rewriting a weak introduction so it clearly addresses the audience

items.prompt:
The BEST reason to seek feedback focused on PURPOSE and AUDIENCE is to:
A) check whether the writing actually reaches and persuades/informs its intended reader
B) copy a classmate's work
C) avoid revising
items.answer: A) check whether the writing actually reaches and persuades/informs its intended reader

steps: Feedback targets purpose/audience. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) check whether the writing actually reaches and persuades/informs its intended reader
